dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL or similar open-source/PC COBOL; uses INSPECT CONVERTING with LOWER-ALPHA/UPPER-ALPHA from copybooks (WSCASE01.CBL), date handling via WSDATE01.CBL, fixed-format with max line length 65, no COMP-3, no CICS/SQL
evidence: EXIT PROGRAM and STOP RUN both present
no EXEC CICS, no EXEC SQL, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Accounts payable voucher file maintenance - add, change, inquire, delete vouchers linked to vendor records and a control file
purpose.summary: VCHMNT01 is a menu-driven batch maintenance program for an accounts payable voucher file. It supports add, change, inquire, and delete operations on voucher records, validating vendor references and managing a control record for auto-incrementing voucher numbers. Fields like PAID-AMOUNT, PAID-DATE, and CHECK-NO are display-only (not modifiable).

notable_features: INSPECT CONVERTING for case normalization using LOWER-ALPHA/UPPER-ALPHA copybook constants
Date entry/validation via shared GET-A-DATE routine (WSDATE01.CBL)
9 COPY statements for file control, FD, and working-storage
No GOTO usage; structured with 123 PERFORMs
Conditional display of SELECTED vs PAID fields based on VOUCHER-PAID-DATE
EXIT PROGRAM present alongside STOP RUN (designed as callable subprogram or standalone)
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 18623 bytes; the display routines for DATE, DUE, DEDUCTIBLE, SELECTED, PAID-AMOUNT, PAID-DATE, CHECK-NO and file I/O routines are not shown but inferred from PERFORM references. Dialect is medium-confidence as the copybook naming style (.CBL extensions, WSCASE01/WSDATE01 pattern) is consistent with textbook/PC COBOL environments such as GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus Personal COBOL.
